assets.label: Provincial Emergency Program, black reconstruction
assets.sourceFile: Risk Management for Outdoor Programs: A Guide for Students
assets.sourceLocator: Front cover, bottom row. The title page credits PEP as a supporter and dates the guide to 2003.
assets.notes: The striped disc contains an open triangle and the slanted PEP initials. The three lines of lettering follow the same diagonal. This colour version follows the supplied reference.
assets.dateNote: The 2003 guide dates the heavier lettering. The two supplied colour samples are undated.
assets.fidelityNote: The circle, triangular opening, bands and initials were constructed geometrically. Of seven faces tested, Nimbus Sans Narrow Bold Oblique gave the closest fit after adjusting its slant, proportions and spacing. The original typeface and specified ink colours remain unverified.

alsoSeen.label: July 1993 JEPP guidelines, cover, with a lighter PEP wordmark
